name: @logprobs/logprobs-highlighter
description: Logprobs Highlighter for DeepSeek Harness: sidecar plugin that proxies DeepSeek chat completions through 127.0.0.1:8787, injects logprobs/top_logprobs, captures token-level log probabilities (content + reasoning_content, M0-verified dual fields), strips and forwards a lean stream to dsh, associates captures with (sessionId, turn, step), and exposes /plugins/logprobs-highlighter/* routes for the client renderer.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/proxy.js && node --check lib/capture.js && node --check lib/assoc.js && node --check lib/baseurl.js && node --check lib/routes.js && node --check lib/shared.js && node --check lib/client.js
